question:
Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Anjum Chopra ?

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Lawn Tennis
Cricket
Badminto
Football
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cricket

Explanation:
Anjum Chopra is a renowned Indian female cricketer. She played international cricket for India from 1995 to 2012. She was a left-handed batter and right-arm medium pace bowler. Anjum played 12 Test matches, 127 One Day Internationals (ODIs), and 18 T20 Internationals. She was honored with the Arjuna Award in 2007. She also served as the former captain of the Indian women's cricket team.

Extra Facts:
Anjum Chopra is regarded as one of the most successful players in Indian women's cricket. She represented India in the Women's Cricket World Cup in 2005 and 2017. Currently, she works as a cricket commentator and analyst. She also served as a member of the BCCI's women's committee in 2018.

question_hi:

Extra Facts:

question:
How many balls are there in an over in cricket?

[SSC CPO 2023]
options: 6
4
7
5
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 6

Explanation:
In cricket, an over consists of 6 balls. This rule is set by the Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC), the guardian of cricket laws. The number of balls per over has been standardized since the 1900s. Earlier, some matches had 4 or 5 balls per over, but since 1980, 6 balls per over became the international standard. This rule applies to all formats, including Test, ODI, and T20 cricket.

Extra Facts:
The concept of an over in cricket dates back to the 19th century. Until 1979-80, overs of 8 balls were used in Australia and England, but later it was reduced to 6. In ODI cricket, each innings consists of 50 overs, while in T20, it is 20 overs per innings. Test cricket has no fixed over limit.

Important Points:
☛ Cricket Rules - Governed by MCC (Marylebone Cricket Club)
☛ Early Overs - Sometimes 4 or 5 balls per over
☛ ODI Cricket - 50 overs per innings
☛ T20 Cricket - 20 overs per innings
☛ Test Cricket - No over limit

In which year did India make its Olympic debut in hockey?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: 1936
1932
1924
1928
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1928

Explanation:
India made its Olympic debut in hockey at the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics. The Indian hockey team participated for the first time and won the gold medal, marking a historic moment. Under the leadership of Dhyan Chand, India dominated the tournament, defeating the Netherlands 3-0 in the final. This victory began India's golden era in hockey, as they went on to win six consecutive Olympic gold medals (1928-1956), a record unmatched in hockey history.

Extra Facts:
In the 1928 Olympics, India played five matches, won all, scored 29 goals, and conceded only one. This performance established India as a hockey superpower. From 1928 to 1956, India won six consecutive Olympic gold medals, a feat yet to be replicated.

question_hi:

Prior to this, Sindhu had won medals at the World Championships in 2013, 2014, 2017, and 2018, but the 2019 victory marked her historic gold medal win.

Extra Facts:
PV Sindhu had earlier won a silver medal at the 2016 Rio Olympics, becoming India's first female badminton Olympic medalist. She was awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian honor, in 2020. After her 2019 World Championship win, Sindhu also clinched gold at the BWF World Tour Finals, further cementing her dominance in global badminton.

question:
In field hockey, in a penalty stroke, an attacker shoots at goal from _________ yards away in a one-on-one confrontation with the goalkeeper.

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: 10
8
7
9
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 7

Explanation:
In field hockey, a penalty stroke is a critical opportunity where the attacker faces the goalkeeper one-on-one. In this situation, the attacker shoots at the goal from a distance of 7 yards. This distance is specified by the International Hockey Federation (FIH) rules. A penalty stroke is awarded when the defending team commits a serious foul inside the circle. This rule ensures fairness and excitement in the game.

Extra Facts:
The penalty stroke was introduced into hockey rules in the 1970s. Before that, penalty corners were used. During a penalty stroke, the goalkeeper can only use their feet and stick to stop the ball. If the goalkeeper commits a foul, the penalty stroke may be retaken or a goal may be awarded.

Important Points:

question_hi:
फील्ड हॉकी में, पेनल्टी स्ट्रोक में, हमलावर खिलाड़ी गोलकीपर के साथ आमने-सामने के टकराव में __________ गज दूर से गोल पर शूट (shoots) करता है।

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options_hi: 10
8
7
9
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 7

Explanation:
फील्ड हॉकी में, पेनल्टी स्ट्रोक एक महत्वपूर्ण अवसर होता है जब हमलावर खिलाड़ी गोलकीपर के साथ आमने-सामने होता है। इस स्थिति में, हमलावर खिलाड़ी 7 गज की दूरी से गोल पर शूट करता है। यह दूरी अंतरराष्ट्रीय हॉकी नियमों (FIH) द्वारा निर्धारित की गई है। पेनल्टी स्ट्रोक तब दिया जाता है जब डिफेंडिंग टीम गोल क्षेत्र के अंदर गंभीर फाउल करती है। यह नियम खेल को निष्पक्ष और रोमांचक बनाए रखने के लिए बनाया गया है।

Extra Facts:
पेनल्टी स्ट्रोक को 1970 के दशक में हॉकी नियमों में शामिल किया गया था। इससे पहले, पेनल्टी कॉर्नर का उपयोग किया जाता था। पेनल्टी स्ट्रोक में गोलकीपर केवल अपने पैरों और स्टिक से ही बॉल को रोक सकता है। यदि गोलकीपर कोई फाउल करता है, तो पेनल्टी स्ट्रोक को दोहराया जा सकता है या गोल दिया जा सकता है।

question:
In Cricket, if the umpire extends both hands horizontally it means_________.

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: dead ball
no ball
run out
wide ball
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is wide ball

Explanation:
In cricket, when the umpire extends both hands horizontally, it signals a wide ball. This gesture is used when the bowler delivers a ball that is out of the batsman's reach and cannot be played fairly. A wide ball results in an extra run being awarded to the batting team, and the ball must be bowled again. This rule ensures that bowlers maintain fairness in their deliveries.

Extra Facts:
The wide ball is determined by the umpire and is considered a fault by the bowler. In T20 and ODI cricket, a wide ball does not usually result in a free hit, unlike a no-ball. The definition of a wide ball is specified under ICC rules and can significantly impact the match outcome.

Important Points:
☛ No ball - When the bowler oversteps the crease while delivering the ball (front foot no ball).
☛ Dead ball - When the ball goes out of play or there is an obstruction.
☛ Run out - When the batsman fails to reach the crease before the wicket is broken.
☛ Wide ball - When the ball is out of the batsman's reach.
☛ Free hit - An extra delivery awarded after a no-ball (batsman cannot be out).

question:
In the context of Basketball, which of the following statements is correct?

[SSC GD 2022]
options: Two teams of five players are required to start a game.
A player is to be substituted within 20 seconds.
The basketball game was invented in 1981.
Each basketball must have weight of minimum 700 grams
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Two teams of five players are required to start a game.

Explanation:
In basketball, each team consists of five players on the court at a time, as per the rules set by FIBA (International Basketball Federation) and NBA (National Basketball Association). The other options are incorrect: the 20-second rule is unrelated to substitutions, basketball was invented in 1891 by Dr. James Naismith, and a standard basketball weighs 567-650 grams (20-22 ounces), not 700 grams.

Extra Facts:
The first official basketball game was played in 1892. FIBA was founded in 1932 and governs international basketball competitions. The NBA, established in 1946, is the world's premier basketball league. Basketball was included in the Olympics for the first time in 1936 (Berlin Games).

Important Points:
☛ Invention of Basketball - 1891 (by Dr. James Naismith)
☛ FIBA Founded - 1932 (International governing body)
☛ NBA Founded - 1946 (World's top basketball league)
☛ Basketball in Olympics - 1936 (First inclusion)
☛ Weight of Basketball - 567-650 grams (20-22 ounces)
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन बास्केटबॉल के संदर्भ में सही है?

[SSC GD 2022]
options_hi: खेल शुरू करने के लिए पांच-पांच खिलाड़ियों की दो टीमों की आवश्यकता होती है।
एक खिलाड़ी को 20 सेकंड के भीतर प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना होता है।
बास्केटबॉल खेल का आविष्कार 1981 में हुआ था।
प्रत्येक बास्केटबॉल का भार कम से कम 700 ग्राम होना चाहिए।
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है खेल शुरू करने के लिए पांच-पांच खिलाड़ियों की दो टीमों की आवश्यकता होती है।

Explanation:
बास्केटबॉल खेल में प्रत्येक टीम में पांच खिलाड़ी होते हैं, जो कोर्ट पर एक साथ खेलते हैं। यह नियम FIBA (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बास्केटबॉल फेडरेशन) और NBA (नेशनल बास्केटबॉल एसोसिएशन) द्वारा निर्धारित है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं: 20 सेकंड का नियम प्रतिस्थापन से संबंधित नहीं है, बास्केटबॉल का आविष्कार 1891 में डॉ. जेम्स नाइस्मिथ ने किया था, और एक बास्केटबॉल का वजन 567-650 ग्राम (20-22 औंस) होता है, न कि 700 ग्राम।

Extra Facts:
बास्केटबॉल का पहला आधिकारिक मैच 1892 में खेला गया था। FIBA की स्थापना 1932 में हुई थी, और यह अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बास्केटबॉल प्रतियोगिताओं का आयोजन करती है। NBA, जिसकी स्थापना 1946 में हुई थी, दुनिया का सबसे प्रसिद्ध बास्केटबॉल लीग है। बास्केटबॉल को 1936 के बर्लिन ओलंपिक में शामिल किया गया था।

Important Points:
☛ बास्केटबॉल का आविष्कार - 1891 (डॉ. जेम्स नाइस्मिथ द्वारा)
☛ FIBA की स्थापना - 1932 (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बास्केटबॉल संगठन)
☛ NBA की स्थापना - 1946 (विश्व का प्रमुख बास्केटबॉल लीग)
☛ ओलंपिक में बास्केटबॉल - 1936 (पहली बार शामिल)
☛ बास्केटबॉल का वजन - 567-650 ग्राम (20-22 औंस)

question:

[SSC GD 2024]

solution:

Explanation:
India won the Cricket World Cup for the first time in 1983. The tournament was held in England, and the Indian team, led by Kapil Dev, created history by defeating the West Indies in the final at Lord's. Extra Facts:

question_hi:

Explanation:
भारत ने पहली बार क्रिकेट विश्व कप 1983 में जीता था। यह विश्व कप इंग्लैंड में आयोजित किया गया था और भारतीय टीम ने कपिल देव की कप्तानी में वेस्टइंडीज को फाइनल में हराकर इतिहास रचा था। यह मैच लॉर्ड्स के मैदान पर खेला गया था और भारत ने वेस्टइंडीज को 43 रनों से हराया था। इस जीत ने भारतीय क्रिकेट को वैश्विक स्तर पर एक नई पहचान दी और देश में क्रिकेट की लोकप्रियता को बढ़ावा दिया।

Extra Facts:
1983 विश्व कप में भारत की टीम को अंडरडॉग माना जा रहा था, लेकिन उन्होंने शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए टूर्नामेंट जीता। कपिल देव ने जिम्बाब्वे के खिलाफ अविस्मरणीय 175 रनों की पारी खेली, जो आज भी याद की जाती है। इस विश्व कप की जीत के बाद भारत में क्रिकेट का स्तर ऊंचा उठा और यह देश का सबसे लोकप्रिय खेल बन गया।
